events.description: Called by the download button, the fallback where the browser shows no PDF; left out, there is none.
events.name: onDownload

props.description:
The PDF's link: a short-lived signed URL minted for this open, on another origin than the page (object storage).
A same-origin link is shown with scripts off, so the frame can never lift its own sandbox.
props.name: src

props.description: The file name, shown as given; it names the frame and the download button.
props.name: name
